maddeler.e:
أستبرئ (form X)
# أَسْتَبْرِئُ (ʔastabriʔu) /ʔas.tab.ri.ʔu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَبْرَأَ (istabraʔa)
# أَسْتَبْرِئَ (ʔastabriʔa) /ʔas.tab.ri.ʔa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَبْرَأَ (istabraʔa)
# أَسْتَبْرِئْ (ʔastabriʔ) /ʔas.tab.riʔ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَبْرَأَ (istabraʔa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
